correctness.rationale: The finite exhaustive certificate enumerates all 90 core words and 32 cut masks, grouping by the exact deck-determining statistic of ordered segment Parikh vectors and three core oriented-pair counts. The table has only class sizes 1, 2, 6 and passes exact mass equalities. Marker order and all gap contents are recovered from the full deck, giving an all-r combinatorial bijection. The r-dependent binomial sums simplify via checked symbolic polynomial identities, and direct independent full-deck enumerations for r=0..5 agree. The asymptotic follows by exact division by (r+6)!/8. Neither finite sampling nor logging alone is invoked as an infinite proof.
